Concrete Compressive Strength dataset

Creator: I-Cheng Yeh
Repository: https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/165/concrete+compressive+strength
Data DOI: https://doi.org/10.24432/C5PK67
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
License URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

LGBO derives its seven-input benchmark by retaining rows with Age <= 100,
dropping the Age column, and renaming the remaining columns. See
docs/benchmark_data.md for the complete processing description.
